tw: A large crane drops large amounts of jelly on Kron, who mounts the jelly mountain.
twc: 大吊车往 Kron 身上倒了大量果冻，他干脆爬上果冻山。

tw: At the international trade fair, Kron trades his tired tin train for a tray of tarts.
twc: 在国际贸易博览会上，Kron 用旧铁皮火车换了一盘水果挞。

tw: Kron builds the tallest wall of all time, then a small ball makes it fall.
twc: Kron 砌了史上最高的墙，一个小球就把它撞倒了。

tw: On their honeymoon, two hungry bunnies eat Kron's honey under the moon.
twc: 两只饿坏的兔子度蜜月，在月亮下吃光了 Kron 的蜂蜜。

tw: Kron sings Beijing opera by the bay, and a jingling grasshopper hops on stage.
twc: Kron 在海湾边唱京剧，一只叮当响的蚱蜢跳上了台。

tw: Kron's host family is a family of friendly ghosts who host famous jam parties.
twc: Kron 的寄宿家庭是一家友善的幽灵，最爱办出名的果酱派对。

tw: Kron's long scarf can snake its way across the lake to wake a snake.
twc: Kron 的长围巾蜿蜒穿过湖面，把一条蛇吵醒了。

tw: Kron secretly sneaks his secret seal sweet cream through the creaky window.
twc: Kron 偷偷从吱呀作响的窗口给他的秘密海豹递甜奶油。
hint: 偷偷养海豹，奶油是暗号。

tw: Kron loves to make jokes about the old oak, until the oak drops acorns on him.
twc: Kron 爱拿老橡树开玩笑，直到橡树往他头上砸橡子。

tw: Can Kron succeed in sucking up a sack of seeds with one straw?
twc: Kron 能成功用一根吸管吸光一袋种子吗？

tw: Kron and his goat go on board the boat, but the goat eats the board.
twc: Kron 和他的山羊上了船，可山羊把甲板吃了。

tw: Why be jealous of the jellyfish, Kron? Your jelly jiggles just as well!
twc: Kron，干吗嫉妒水母？你的果冻也一样会晃！

tw: Kron likes to make a point of pointing at every pointy pine cone.
twc: Kron 特意要指一指每一颗尖尖的松果。

tw: Kron's sand castle meets a natural disaster: one wave, faster than a gnat.
twc: Kron 的沙堡遇到了自然灾害：一个浪，比小虫还快。
hint: 沙堡的天灾，只是一个浪。

tw: "Grow up!" crows the crow, but Kron just rows his rubber boat in the bath.
twc: 乌鸦叫道“长大吧！”，Kron 却还在浴缸里划橡皮船。

w: have no choice but to do
tw: In a noisy oyster bar, Kron's toys have no choice but to do yoga.
twc: 在吵闹的生蚝吧里，Kron 的玩具别无选择，只好做瑜伽。

tw: Kron lets three hens run free, and they run up a tree with his tea.
twc: Kron 放三只母鸡自由跑，它们端着他的茶跑上了树。
hint: 放它们自由，茶也自由了。

tw: Kron likes to lie around on a round lion who lies around all day.
twc: Kron 爱躺在一头圆滚滚的狮子身上，狮子也整天躺着。

tw: On the plane, Kron and a camel complain about the plain bread and butter.
twc: 在飞机上，Kron 和一头骆驼抱怨淡而无味的黄油面包。

tw: Kron waves a fish to catch the eye of the shy cat high on the catwalk.
twc: Kron 挥着一条鱼，想引起T台上那只害羞猫的注意。
